import copy, json
from work import evaluate

p={'edges': {'a>b': {}, 'b>c': {'role': 'op'}}, 'retry_limit': 2}
cases=[
 ({'from':'a','to':'b'}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'x'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'c','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'c','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for req, expected in cases:
    rb, pb=copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(p)
    actual=evaluate(req,p)
    assert actual == expected, (req,actual,expected)
    assert req == rb and p == pb
    assert set(actual) == {'ok','value','reason'}
print('all evaluate checks passed')

import json
from work import evaluate
with open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
expected=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]
assert report == expected, (report,expected)
assert isinstance(report,list)
print('report matches requests and current policy')

index 90aaa01..7cfb3c8 100644
--- a/work.py
+++ b/work.py
@@ -1 +1,30 @@
-# Complete the required API and report.
+"""Evaluate state-transition requests against a supplied policy."""
+
+
+def evaluate(request, policy):
+    """Return a policy decision without modifying request or policy."""
+    edge_key = f"{request.get('from')}>{request.get('to')}"
+    edges = policy.get("edges", {})
+
+    if edge_key not in edges:
+        return {"ok": False, "value": None, "reason": "blocked"}
+
+    edge = edges[edge_key]
+    required_role = edge.get("role")
+    if required_role is not None and request.get("role") != required_role:
+        return {"ok": False, "value": None, "reason": "permission"}
+
+    if request.get("retry"):
+        attempts = request.get("attempts")
+        retry_limit = policy.get("retry_limit")
+        if (
+            isinstance(attempts, bool)
+            or not isinstance(attempts, int)
+            or isinstance(retry_limit, bool)
+            or not isinstance(retry_limit, int)
+            or attempts < 0
+            or attempts >= retry_limit
+        ):
+            return {"ok": False, "value": None, "reason": "retry_limit"}
+
+    return {"ok": True, "value": request.get("to"), "reason": "ok"}
